target.title: fix(imessage): sanitize outbound tool traces
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

iMessage outbound delivery already had channel-specific cleanup for older internal scaffolding, but it did not run the shared `sanitizeAssistantVisibleText` delivery sanitizer used by the other #90684 channel fixes. Compact tool-trace failure lines could still remain in text passed through the outbound adapter.

Refs #90684.

## Why This Change Was Made

This composes `sanitizeAssistantVisibleText` into the existing iMessage outbound sanitizer instead of replacing the iMessage-specific cleanup. That keeps the existing iMessage protections for separators and role markers while matching the accepted sibling-channel pattern for stripping assistant-visible tool traces before delivery.

## User Impact

iMessage recipients no longer see assistant internal tool-trace banners such as failed tool-call lines in outbound replies. Normal user-facing prose is preserved.

## Evidence

- Current branch head: `2fd2b36b49`, rebased onto upstream `main` `30b3a7cded` (2026-07-09).
- The iMessage touched-file diff is unchanged from the live-proofed head `cdef8c6101`:
  - `git diff --exit-code cdef8c61013da451fd70cfeaeab9bc6d5d13f694..HEAD -- extensions/imessage/src/monitor/sanitize-outbound.ts extensions/imessage/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts`
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`
- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 OPENCLAW_VITEST_FS_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=/tmp/oc-vitest-imessage-sanitize-20260709 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/imessage/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts extensions/imessage/src/monitor/sanitize-outbound.test.ts --reporter=verbose`
  - 2 test files passed
  - 14 tests passed
- Previous full pre-PR gate (`openclaw-pre-pr.sh`) passed end-to-end on the live-proofed head `cdef8c6101`, including `pnpm check:changed`. This refresh is a base-only rebase with the iMessage touched files unchanged from that proofed head; GitHub CI is rerunning the full exact-head matrix.

## Evidence — real iMessage delivery proof (redacted)

Setup: the PR head was checked out in an isolated dev worktree (no changes to any live gateway install). The patched hook `imessagePlugin.outbound.sanitizeText` — the exact hook the gateway invokes on outbound text before delivery — was executed directly from the PR head, and its returned text was then delivered over a real iMessage send from a signed-in macOS Messages account and read back from that device's Messages store (`chat.db`).

**1. Patched code path, run at PR head `cdef8c6101`:**

```
$ node --import tsx -e '
import { imessagePlugin } from "./extensions/imessage/src/channel.ts";
const f = imessagePlugin.outbound?.sanitizeText;
const banner = "PR #101430 proof: rebase complete, tests green.\n⚠️ 🛠️ `search repos (agent)` failed";
const prose = "PR #101430 proof: ordinary prose is preserved.";
console.log("banner-in :", JSON.stringify(banner));
console.log("banner-out:", JSON.stringify(f({ text: banner, payload: { text: banner } })));
console.log("prose-in  :", JSON.stringify(prose));
console.log("prose-out :", JSON.stringify(f({ text: prose, payload: { text: prose } })));
'
banner-in : "PR #101430 proof: rebase complete, tests green.\n⚠️ 🛠️ `search repos (agent)` failed"
banner-out: "PR #101430 proof: rebase complete, tests green."
prose-in  : "PR #101430 proof: ordinary prose is preserved."
prose-out : "PR #101430 proof: ordinary prose is preserved."
```

**2. Real iMessage delivery of the sanitized outputs (recipient + account redacted):**

```
$ imsg send --to +1206•••••72 --service imessage --json --text "PR #101430 proof: rebase complete, tests green."
{"status":"sent"}
$ imsg send --to +1206•••••72 --service imessage --json --text "PR #101430 proof: ordinary prose is preserved."
{"status":"sent"}
```

**3. Device-side readback from the Mac's Messages store confirms what was actually delivered — tool-trace banner absent, ordinary prose preserved verbatim:**

```
{"text":"PR #101430 proof: rebase complete, tests green.","is_from_me":true,"created_at":"2026-07-08T02:19:08.515Z", …}
{"text":"PR #101430 proof: ordinary prose is preserved.","is_from_me":true,"created_at":"2026-07-08T02:19:08.609Z", …}

$ sqlite3 -json ~/Library/Messages/chat.db "SELECT ROWID, service, is_from_me FROM message WHERE ROWID IN (852,853);"
[{"ROWID":852,"service":"iMessage","is_from_me":1},
 {"ROWID":853,"service":"iMessage","is_from_me":1}]
```

Both proof messages were delivered on the `iMessage` service (no SMS fallback), and the delivered text is byte-identical to the patched hook's output: the tool-trace banner line was removed before delivery and ordinary prose passed through unchanged. Scope note: delivery used the `imsg` CLI against the same signed-in Messages account rather than a full gateway roundtrip; the changed code path itself (the outbound `sanitizeText` hook) was exercised directly from the PR head, matching the proof pattern of the merged sibling-channel fixes.

AI-assisted change, manually reviewed and validated.
